description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ikiriyagoda, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No.710031 (24/0981)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring title determinations for multiple land parcels in Ikiriyagoda village. The content focuses on land ownership, cadastral mapping, and property registration matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). It does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
